Compact download and install progress for app updates and content packs, as a toast, a pill or an inline row. A metered connection pauses the download until the person agrees to continue.

<ComponentStates component="UpdateProgress" />

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `packs ensure <pack…>`.

    **Styled part.** `screens.update_progress(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `ProgressView` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    **Drop-in.** `update apply` (`updateApplyFlow`): the download as a bar with its percentage, size
    and time left, redrawn at most ten times a second (Esc cancels), then the install's outcome.
    `packs ensure <packIds...>` draws the same bar for each pack.

    **Styled part.** The `progressSpans` and `percent` primitives in a rail row, and `LiveRegion` for
    the redraws.

    **Headless.** `progressView(done, total, phase?)`: `queued`, `downloading`, `installing` or
    `done`, with the `fraction`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
